GRA-A2-11-Q5: Which sentence has the correct form after will?
I will to close the window.
Will is followed by the base form close, not to close, closing or closed.
GRA-A2-14-Q3: Which sentence uses the if-clause correctly?
If I will finish early, I will stay at home.
If I finish early, I will stay at home.
If I finishes early, I will stay at home.
If I finish early, I will staying at home.
In a basic first conditional, use present simple in the if-clause and will plus a base verb in the result clause.
GRA-A2-14-Q10: You may miss the last bus tonight. Which sentence gives a realistic future plan?
If we miss the last bus, we will book a taxi.
If we will miss the last bus, we booked a taxi yesterday.
If we missed every bus, we are book a taxi.
A realistic future possibility can use if + present simple and will + base verb.
GRA-A2-06-Q13: Trip instructions say: sturdy shoes are compulsory; bringing a map is optional because the guide provides maps. Select one sentence that expresses BOTH rules correctly.
We must not wear sturdy shoes, and we have to bring a map.
We do not have to wear sturdy shoes, and we must bring a map.
We have to wear sturdy shoes, and we do not have to bring a map.
We have to wear sturdy shoes, and we must not bring a map.
Have to shows the required shoes; do not have to means a map is not required, rather than forbidden.
GRA-A2-05-Q11: Maya has decided to paint a sign at home tomorrow, but she has not arranged a meeting with anyone. Select one sentence that expresses HER INTENTION.
Maya paints a sign every Friday.
Maya is going to paint a sign tomorrow.
Maya has painted a sign already.
Be going to describes Maya’s previously decided future intention; the other options describe past actions or a routine.
GRA-B1-03-Q4: I opened my bag and realized that I ___ my wallet at home.
Forgetting the wallet happened before the later realization, so past perfect had forgotten is appropriate.
